title: Same-URL reload lacks document identity for page-result invalidation
surface: Shared active-tab identity; Showcase Prepare and Snapshot
reproduction: Run Prepare or Snapshot on a page.
Reload the same tab at the same URL without closing the side panel.
Inspect whether the previous document report remains current, or a pending old-document completion appears after reload.
expected: Results and pending completions are scoped to the actual document, not merely the tab ID and URL.
actual: Source trace shows useActiveTab lacks document identity and consumers invalidate only tab ID/URL; same-URL reload is not distinguished. Native reproduction remains unverified.
severity: S2: old-document results can appear current
verification_status: Source-supported gap; needs controlled regression and native reproduction before triage. D58 does not claim to fix it.

transition_history.reason: Sibling census identified document identity gap beyond D58 run ordering.

Source trace confirms id/URL-only keys and identifies existing Chrome top-frame document-ID consumers; controlled/native reproduction still pending. Shared design requires race/consumer review before edits.
